questionText:
Consider a system with a processor and a 4 KB direct mapped cache with block size of 16 bytes. The system has a 16 MB physical memory. Four words P, Q, R, and S are accessed by the processor in the same order 10 times. That is, there are a total of 40 memory references in the sequence P, Q, R, S, P, Q, R, S,...

Assume that the cache memory is initially empty. The physical addresses of the words are given below (1 word = 1 byte).

P: 0x845B32, Q: 0x845B26, R: 0x845B36, S: 0x846B32

Which of the following statements is/are true?

Note: 1K=$2^{10}$ and 1M=$2^{20}$
options: Every access to P results in a cache miss
Every access to R results in a cache hit
Every access to Q results in a cache miss
Except the first access to S, all subsequent accesses to S result in cache hits
explanation:
Given parameters:
• Cache Size = $4\text{ KB} = 2^{12}\text{ bytes}$
• Block Size = $16\text{ bytes} = 2^4\text{ bytes}$
• Number of Cache Lines = $\frac{4\text{ KB}}{16\text{ bytes}} = 256 = 2^8\text{ lines}$
• Physical Memory = $16\text{ MB} = 2^{24}\text{ bytes}$ (24-bit physical address)

Address Field Breakdown:
• Block Offset = $4\text{ bits}$ (Bits 0 to 3)
• Cache Line Index = $8\text{ bits}$ (Bits 4 to 11)
• Tag = $12\text{ bits}$ (Bits 12 to 23)

Analyzing the Physical Addresses:
1. P = 0x845B32: Block Address = $\text{0x845B3}$, Cache Index = $\text{0xB3}$, Tag = $\text{0x845}$
2. Q = 0x845B26: Block Address = $\text{0x845B2}$, Cache Index = $\text{0xB2}$, Tag = $\text{0x845}$
3. R = 0x845B36: Block Address = $\text{0x845B3}$ (Same block as P), Cache Index = $\text{0xB3}$, Tag = $\text{0x845}$
4. S = 0x846B32: Block Address = $\text{0x846B3}$, Cache Index = $\text{0xB3}$, Tag = $\text{0x846}$

Execution Trace for Each Iteration (P, Q, R, S):
• Q maps uniquely to Line $\text{0xB2}$. It misses on the 1st access and hits on all subsequent 9 accesses.
• P, R, and S all map to Line $\text{0xB3}$. Notice P and R are in the exact same memory block.

In every iteration of (P, Q, R, S):
1. Access P: Evicts block S from Line $\text{0xB3}$ and loads block P (Tag $\text{0x845}$). $\rightarrow$ MISS (all 10 times).
2. Access Q: Line $\text{0xB2}$ is unaffected. $\rightarrow$ HIT (except 1st iteration).
3. Access R: Same block as P! Block P is currently in Line $\text{0xB3}$. $\rightarrow$ HIT (all 10 times).
4. Access S: Evicts block P/R from Line $\text{0xB3}$ and loads block S (Tag $\text{0x846}$). $\rightarrow$ MISS (all 10 times).

Conclusion:
• Statement (A) is TRUE.
• Statement (B) is TRUE.
• Statement (C) is FALSE.
• Statement (D) is FALSE.
